title: openstack-cinder-provider-kog values
description: Values for the OpenStack Cinder KOG chart. It renders the RestDefinition for Cinder block-storage v3 volumes and a stateless Keystone auth-bridge proxy in front of Cinder.

restdefinitions.description: Per-resource RestDefinitions. Each can be turned off and carries its API group and Kind.

volume.description: Cinder Volume: create, get, delete over /volumes (block storage v3). No update verb (docs/overview.md says why).

enabled.description: Render the Volume RestDefinition and its OpenAPI ConfigMap.

resourceGroup.description: API group of the generated Volume and VolumeConfiguration CRDs.

authBridge.description: Stateless Keystone-auth reverse proxy (openstacksdk). It authenticates with clouds.yaml, finds the block-storage endpoint in the catalog, adds a fresh X-Auth-Token and forwards the controller's plain-HTTP calls.

enabled.description: Deploy the auth-bridge Deployment, Service and script ConfigMap.

replicaCount.description: auth-bridge replicas. The proxy is stateless.

cloudsSecret.description: Secret in the release namespace with key clouds.yaml. On krateo-openstack-blueprint with kogCredentials.enabled: openstack-kog-clouds.

serviceType.description: Catalog service type to proxy. block-storage matches a volumev3 catalog entry; volumev3 itself would trigger version discovery.

upstreamEndpoint.description: Override the discovered endpoint. Empty: use the catalog. Otherwise the block-storage v3 root with no project id, e.g. http://cinder-api.openstack.svc.cluster.local:8776/v3.

image.description: Image that runs the proxy. It must provide python3 and openstacksdk.

service.description: The Service the generated controller calls.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations for the auth-bridge pod. Unset by default.

nodeSelector.description: nodeSelector for the auth-bridge pod. Unset by default.

tolerations.description: Tolerations for the auth-bridge pod. Unset by default.

affinity.description: Affinity for the auth-bridge pod. Unset by default.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name in resource names.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the full resource name prefix.
